html:
Plan for the archive: about 30,000 notes will be waiting at the end of the import (12 per folder). The helper checks one folder at a time, comparing each note with the other files in the same folder.

  • Cost with the large model: about $0.20–0.30 per folder, $400–600 for all. A small model: about 5 times less.
  • Today's limit is $5 a week, which means about 2 years to finish. About $50 a week finishes in ~10 weeks.
  • First a 10-folder trial (~$3) gives the real cost and how many pass. Build: ~1.5 days.
Weekly limit after the trial

One rule: some notes appear in only one source file (for example a date or a count written once). Under today's rule they can never pass, because there is no second file.

Can one source file be enough for those?
